sections.title: Questions about SEO services in Egypt

items.question: Is search behavior in Egypt different from other markets?
items.answer: Search phrasing and the level of competition for the same terms differ, and many searchers tend to compare options before getting in touch. That's why we build keywords and pages on real search data, not generic lists.

items.question: How do you decide which keywords deserve their own page?
items.answer: We create a separate page when a phrase reflects a different service or need with its own search intent. Closely related variations are grouped on one page so visibility isn't split between pages.

items.question: Can you improve my current website without rebuilding it?
items.answer: In most cases, yes. We start by fixing what's holding back indexing, page structure and content, and we only recommend a rebuild if the platform itself prevents optimization.

items.question: What's the difference between optimizing a service page and creating new content?
items.answer: A service page targets people who want to buy or get in touch now, while new content targets people looking for answers before they decide. We use the first to bring in orders and the second to expand visibility and feed your service pages.

items.question: How do you set priorities in the first month?
items.answer: We weigh the size of the opportunity against the strength of the competition and how close the page is to an order, then start with what can be improved quickly for a noticeable impact before moving on to work that takes longer.

items.question: How do you measure inquiries and orders that come from search?
items.answer: We set up contact and order events in Google Analytics 4 and connect them to the organic channel and to the pages visitors came from, so you can see the impact of each page on its own.

items.question: Does the service include follow-up on implementation and indexing?
items.answer: Yes. We follow up on the changes being implemented and on pages appearing in the index, fix whatever is preventing them from being indexed, and include this in the progress report.

items.question: How is the cost of SEO services determined?
items.answer: It depends on the size of your site, the competition and the scope of work required. Check our pricing page, then book a call to discuss your situation.
